title: Poverty as a Challenge
subtitle: Understanding the multifaceted nature of poverty
subject: Social Science (Economics)
author: Shine Academy EduOS AI
learning_outcomes: Understand the meaning of poverty and its multidimensional nature.
Analyze poverty estimates and vulnerable groups in India.
Evaluate anti-poverty measures taken by the government.
Connect modern concepts of poverty with ancient Indian philosophical views on wealth and welfare.

ai_context.learning_goal: The student should master the concept of poverty, its indicators, causes, and the measures taken to alleviate it, while understanding the historical and cultural context.
common_misconceptions: Poverty is only about not having enough money (it's multidimensional).
Poverty is evenly distributed across all states and social groups in India.
ai_context.tutor_hint: If the student is confused about poverty line calculations, ask: 'How do you think we can measure the minimum amount a person needs to survive daily?'
